_default.title: Founder risk
_default.detail: Single founder dependency — recruit a co-founder or first hire within 6 months.

_default.title: Runway risk
_default.detail: Keep ≥ 12 months runway; cut scope aggressively if revenue lags.

_default.title: Distribution risk
_default.detail: A great product with no distribution will fail. Plan a channel before launch.

_default.title: Regulatory risk
_default.detail: Map the rules that apply to your data, payments, and content from day one.

ai.title: Model lock-in
ai.detail: Abstract model access behind an interface so you can swap providers without rewrites.

ai.title: Data leakage
ai.detail: Never send customer data to a third-party model without scrubbing PII.

fintech.title: Compliance
fintech.detail: Treat compliance as a product feature, not a tax.
